subject: maths
question: Height of a cone is 15 cm and radius of its base is 14 cm. What is the volume of the cone?
solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) = 15 cm

Radius (r) = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cone (V) = dfrac{1}{3} pi r² h

**Calculation:**

V = dfrac{1}{3} pi (14)² (15)

⇒ V = dfrac{1}{3} pi (196) (15) 

⇒ V = dfrac{1}{3} pi (2940)

⇒ V = 980 pi

⇒ V = 980 × 22/7

⇒ V = 3080 cm3

**∴ The correct answer is option (3) 3080 cm³.**
